No. The evidence shows the 67.7 ha loss happened in 2020, before the 2020-12-31 cut-off, so it falls outside the post-baseline period.

For 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-31, no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected. Hansen GFC covered the whole asset (valid data fraction 1.0). The only post-baseline loss was 0.4 ha in 2021, in patches below the 0.5 ha event threshold, so it was not counted as an event.

JRC's 2020 reference map also shows 0 ha of forest on the property.

Limits: small changes, edge changes, or changes narrower than the 30 m pixels could be missed. This is not a compliance finding, such as EUDR compliant or deforestation-free. It also says nothing about periods outside 2021-2025.
